sunRadius.note: engulfing the Sun Station at 690s requires the accelerating curve; a straight line would hit 2315m at t=207s

sunStation.note: the sun's surface first touches the station near edge at contactAtS and reaches the station centre (= R_sun 2315 m = OWClock 690 s) at centreAtS; both are emergent from the shared map

events.name: Loop Begins
events.label: 循环开始
events.visual: 全部天体复位到初值；探测炮完整、炮口朝种子方向

events.label: 探测炮解体并发射探测器
events.visual: 炮体切 broken 变体；探测器沿抛物轨离场

events.name: Sand Begins Flowing
events.label: 沙漏开始沙流
events.visual: 灰烬双星 → 余烬双星沙流粒子带；双星贴图开始渐变

events.name: Interloper Opens
events.label: 闯入者冰壳展开（第 1 次）
events.visual: 冰壳变体 open + 逸气粒子

events.name: Interloper Closes
events.label: 闯入者冰壳收拢（第 1 次）
events.visual: 冰壳变体 closed

events.name: Stranger's Sails Deploy
events.label: 陌生者张帆
events.visual: 几何 + 亮度变化（cloaked → sails）

events.name: Sun Station Destroyed
events.label: 太阳站被膨胀的太阳吞没
events.visual: 太阳视半径越过太阳站视轨道半径（几何自然发生）

events.name: Interloper Opens
events.label: 闯入者冰壳展开（第 2 次）
events.visual: 同第 1 次

events.name: Interloper Closes
events.label: 闯入者冰壳收拢（第 2 次）
events.visual: 同第 1 次

events.name: Dam Bursts
events.label: 深巨星水坝崩塌
events.visual: 深巨星上一道细小高光（低优先，可弃）

events.name: Quantum Tower Exits White Hole
events.label: 量子塔从白洞出现
events.visual: 白洞旁新增塔体几何

events.name: Interloper Opens
events.label: 闯入者冰壳展开（第 3 次）
events.visual: 冰壳 open，随后坠日

events.name: Interloper Collides with Sun
events.label: 闯入者坠日
events.visual: 闯入者淡出 + 太阳局部闪光

events.name: Hourglass Sand Stops Flowing
events.label: 沙流停止
events.visual: 沙流粒子停；双星切 empty 变体

events.name: Cinder Isles Tower Completely Falls
events.label: 深巨星高塔坍落
events.visual: 深巨星上细小几何变化（低优先，可弃）

events.name: Beginning of the End
events.label: 终局开始
events.visual: 太阳转红、膨胀加速的视觉开端

events.name: Supernova
events.label: 超新星
events.visual: 红日坍缩 → 转蓝 → 爆炸白闪

events.name: ATP Black Hole Opens
events.label: 灰烬双星黑洞开启
events.visual: 灰烬双星旁出现黑洞点

events.name: Loop Ends
events.label: 循环结束
events.visual: 复位到初值（白闪遮盖接缝）

decorative.label: Hollow's Lantern 流星
decorative.visual: 发光轨迹 + 撞击闪光；每次撞击使脆空破洞等级 +1（上限 5）

decorative.label: 背景星熄灭
decorative.visual: 星点按哈希顺序逐个熄灭
